items.text: Theexperiment showninFigure 18.9 demonstrates that thepressureina liquid increases with depth.We can work out the pressure difference by thinking about a column ofwater,as shown in Figure18.10.

items.label: text
items.text: The force at thebottom of the column isequal to all the weight ofwater above it.The volume of this water(V)is found by multiplying the area of its base(A) by the height (h) of the column.We can work out the mass (m)of the water by multiplying thevolume(Axh)by the density(o).

items.label: text
items.text: The force（F)on thebottomof the water column isequal to the weightof this volume of water,which is the mass,m(Axhxp)，multiplied by the gravitational field strength(g)(see page 34).
